name: Bob Ledger Tools
description: Expand Bob daily-note snippets and ledger time ranges, navigate and adjust Pomodoro entries, render the live plan-budget bob-plan block, render task freshness stamps as compact marks, render [priority::] fields as signal-bar priority marks, render created/scheduled/completion/cancelled dates as compact date marks (including in Tasks query results), render `#task` tags as a teal hash task-tag mark (hidden in Tasks query results) and `#task #ref` pairs as an open-book ref mark, and render Depends-On lines as live dependency chips. Render Task Links under today's open Pomodoros with In Progress half-ring marks and read-time unblocked hand-off glyphs.
author: Bryan
